speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Congratulations, Roberto, first win. I mean,  regardless of what was happening elsewhere,  
your players had to do their job today. Are you  pleased with the character? Yeah, I think in the  
first half, the first 30, 35 minutes, we played  well. We didn't create big chances to score,  
but anyway, we had the control of the game,  total control of the game. And then maybe,  
I don't know, the pressure. Maybe. We didn't  win any game in this season, in this 2026.  
Maybe this pressure. Maybe because we played  against Wolverhampton, who are relegated, and we  
lost distances, we lost order on the pitch. Every  one of us wanted to go one to one. But anyway,  
I'm happy for the result. I hope this result can  change something in our head, in our mentality and  
for the other results, we can't. It is already  very tough to win a game for us. If we put our  
head on the other teams, it becomes too tough  for me. Can I ask about Xavi and Solanke? Yeah,  
yeah. Xavi, Solanke. Solanke is a muscular  injury. I don't know what level of injury, and  
for Xavi it is a problem of knee. We are going  to see in the next days, Monday or Tuesday. For  
Solanke it is not a big problem. I don't know  how many games we lose him, but I would like to  
know the real situation of Xavi because the knee  is always different than the muscular injury. We  
were trying to work out what happened. It looked  like he got back up and then he fell down again.  
Yeah, he felt pain, but now I spoke with him two  minutes ago. He feels better than at the beginning  
of the injury. But that was a really big moment.  Yeah, he deserved this day because he played very  
well today, especially today. He was crucial for  the result. He deserves everything because he's a  
good guy, he's a good goalkeeper. And especially  after Madrid, he deserves one day like today. You  
said one win could be transformative. What was the  mood like afterwards in the dressing room? Yes,  
I hope so, but I wouldn't like to  lose any other players because Romero,  
Kudus, now Solanke and maybe Xavi. We can win the  games with the players, not with the coaches. The  
coaches are important, but the players are more  important. But I want to be positive. Mathys Tel  
played 45 minutes very well in the first half. At  the beginning of the first half, also Kolo Muani  
started the game very well and then he lost,  I don't know, confidence. You have to go every  
day for lunch with Kolo Muani this week. Every  day, breakfast, lunch and dinner because he's a  
top player as a potential, and I want him to play  better. He feels better on the pitch. He tries to  
go in one to one, to shoot, something more with  more energy, because he can do. He can do that.  
Did you say you went for lunch with him last week  or you need to? No, no. Me and Kolo Muani, just  
two. That would be a problem if I go to dinner?  No, thank you. We spoke about the players' minds  
with that win. You're two points from safety. Is  there that belief that they can get to safety?  
But I think the players, they know what they are  and what they can do on the pitch, especially this  
season. Because it's true we didn't win a game in  2026, but on the table in Champions League they  
finished in fifth place, no? And Champions League,  I think, is not so easy, or is easier than Premier  
League. So they have to be positive. They have  to feel full confidence because they are good.  
We have not to see the other results, for example  West Ham, and we have to move on and to prepare  
the next games. Now the first game is Villa Park.  Stop. Just a final to Jay and Tom, please. Can I  
just ask you about that moment at full time where  it looked like you were fist pumping in front of  
the fans? What does that mean for you and the  squad, and what does it mean to the fans? Yes,  
because I believe to stay up. If I stay here,  it is because I'm positive. Now because I'm a  
coach of Tottenham, I have to. Tottenham is not  important on the pitch. If you are Tottenham or  
another team, the most important are the qualities  of the players and the level. The human level of  
the players was a surprise for me because I didn't  know them, and when I knew better my players,  
I understood there was the possibility, the chance  to stay up. We have two points, not 10 points. We  
have two points from West Ham. West Ham, they  are a good team, but also Tottenham are very,  
very good players and very good team. Sorry, can I  just check, what surprised you about the players?  
What was it? Yes, because when I watch the game,  or if you watch the game from the stand or TV, you  
can't understand if they have the right spirit,  they have the right attitude. And I work with  
them every day, and all players, professional,  good guys. They are suffering for this situation.  
Just to give them confidence and order on the  pitch because I didn't like the second half at  
all. We could play better. We have to play better,  better, much better than the second half. We have  
to play like the first 30 minutes, maybe creating  more chances to score and more shots on goal. Tom,  
final one. Roberto, on that note, Tottenham  have struggled to make chances for a long  
time. Now Xavi is injured, Solanke as well.  How much are you going to have to get creative  
to find different ways? Well, we can play with  Mathys Tel on the left, Kolo Muani on the right,  
Souza on the right, Bergvall on the left. We  have to create. I don't want to change too much,  
three defenders, four defenders. I don't want to  put more confusion on the players, especially this  
season, because they changed a lot of tactical  dispositions. I want to be clear and simple. But  
for your question, we need to stay strong in the  head, positive in ourselves. Okay, thank you.
title: Roberto De Zerbi post-match press conference | Wolves 0-1 Tottenham Hotspur | Premier League
